title: The Type III realisation conjecture of Kirkland and Šmigoc
summary: Kirkland and Šmigoc constructed a family of stochastic matrices realising the Type III boundary polynomials in the Karpelevič region and conjectured that, conversely, every stochastic realisation of such a polynomial must come from their construction. We prove this conjecture for the full nonzero parameter range $0<α\le1$, for genuine Type III reduced Ito polynomials of order $n$, $f_α(x)=x^y(x^q-(1-α))^d-α^d$, where $n=qd+y$.
